text: Are you currently vomiting blood, or have you noticed black, tarry stools?
Have you noticed blood in your stool, and if so, is it a large amount or ongoing?
Are you feeling dizzy, lightheaded, or have you fainted?
Is your swallowing difficulty getting worse over time, especially with solid foods?
Did the swallowing difficulty start suddenly, along with slurred speech, facial drooping, or arm/leg weakness?
Are you unable to keep any fluids down?
For a newborn or infant: is the vomit green or yellow in color?
Is your abdominal pain severe, constant, and getting worse, or does your belly feel hard/rigid?
Have you stopped passing gas or having bowel movements, along with a bloated belly and vomiting?
Are you over 50 years old and experiencing this indigestion/heartburn for the first time?
Have you lost weight without trying, over the last 3 months?
Do you have a fever along with your bowel symptoms?
Have you been told you have low iron / anemia recently, without a clear cause?
Do you have a severe headache or stiff neck along with the vomiting?
Does anyone in your immediate family have colon cancer or inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's/ulcerative colitis)?
Has the rectal bleeding or discharge lasted more than 4-6 weeks?
How long have you had this symptom?
Is the discomfort clearly related to eating meals?
Are you currently pregnant?
Are you taking any new medications recently (e.g. opioids, iron supplements, antacids)?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you noticed blood in your stool or experienced unexplained weight loss?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you had hard, infrequent bowel movements or trouble passing stool for the past few weeks?
[LLM DRAFT] Are you having severe abdominal pain along with your constipation?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you been passing hard stools less than three times a week for the past month?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you feel like you have a blockage preventing bowel movements, or need to press on your vagina or perineum to help pass stool?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you noticed blood in your stool or experienced unexpected, significant weight loss alongside your constipation?
[LLM DRAFT] Does your newborn frequently bring up milk or food shortly after feeding?
[LLM DRAFT] Is your newborn forcefully vomiting or not gaining weight properly?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have fewer than three bowel movements a week?
[LLM DRAFT] Have you had persistent constipation for months or years that does not respond to standard over-the-counter fiber supplements or laxatives?
[LLM DRAFT] Did your severe constipation start suddenly along with unexplained weight loss or blood in your stool?
